description: Session-derived regression cases for the Billy accounting skill and workflow tools.

cases.given: The requested company differs from the selected stable Billy profile ID.
expected: Name both the requested company and selected profile
forbidden: Continue because the display names look similar

cases.given: A collection response exceeds maxResponseChars or not every page was read.
expected: Retry with a smaller page size or narrower filter

cases.given: The user can see an uploaded inbox document in Billy, but the documented attachments API returns no linked record.
expected: Use browser read-only confirmation when available
forbidden: Claim that no document was uploaded

cases.given: A bank line has status booked, but its match is unapproved or has no subject associations.
expected: Show match approval and association evidence separately

cases.given: The ledger balance agrees with the imported lines, but the newest feed timestamp predates the real statement.
expected: Keep feed freshness separate from ledger balance
forbidden: Claim the real bank account is fully reconciled

cases.given: A proposed duplicate bank line gained an approved match or subject association after preview.
expected: Recompute and report a changed digest
forbidden: Delete based only on date, description, and amount

cases.given: The user cancels the native approval for a multi-line cleanup.
A cleanup is retried after some idempotent DELETE calls succeeded and the client lost the response.
expected: Do not recreate or double-book anything
Verify the final aggregate target set
forbidden: Report failure solely because a target is already absent

cases.given: A supplier bill is USD while the card settlement and bank line are DKK.
expected: Report booked DKK value and realized exchange difference separately
forbidden: Rewrite the bill as DKK to force the bank line to match

cases.given: Two VAT return fields are wrong by offsetting amounts while the net payable total is unchanged.
expected: Mark the period not ready until field differences are resolved

cases.given: The return was filed and paid manually, so no SKAT transaction ID is present in Billy.
expected: Distinguish prepared, submitted, Billy-settled, authority-paid, and bank-reconciled states
forbidden: Infer filing failure from a missing skatTransactionId

cases.given: A proposed correction affects a filed VAT period or locked accounting period.
expected: Require explicit user direction and correction treatment
